one_line: Multiplayer Texas Hold'em where each player can bring an AI copilot with seat-safe live state.
what_it_does: Lets humans play poker against bots or other people while a compatible agent reads the exact public/private hand context and returns advice; humans make the moves.
leverage_rationale: Seat-scoped structured state is materially better than asking a UI-driving agent to reconstruct cards, legal actions, history, and changing game state, especially with private information.
leverage_evidence: Pitch explicitly says each copilot receives live, seat-safe game state.
Description identifies private hole cards, legal actions, complete hand history, and shared live state as the core problem.
execution_rationale: The packet describes a playable game and supplies multiple frame sheets, but no transcript or end-to-end observed proof is available; claimed completeness is plausible but bounded by evidence.
execution_evidence: Demo is marked alive and frame sheets show a poker/game interface.
About text describes playing against bots or people and copilot advice.
impact_rationale: Poker players have a clear desire for context-aware coaching without manually restating a hand; the multiplayer copilot framing offers credible niche value.
impact_evidence: Explicit audience is poker players using AI assistance.
Advice is based on exact cards, board, pot, stacks, and legal actions.
creativity_rationale: Making each seat a human-plus-agent participant with private, seat-safe context is a fresh and memorable application of WebMCP to a game.
creativity_evidence: Two-minds-per-seat concept.
Agent advice is returned to the live table while the human retains agency.
usability_note: The described copilot model is understandable and keeps the human action boundary clear; multiplayer/private-state complexity may add friction.
red_flags: No video transcript and no direct tool-call evidence in the packet.
standouts: Strong seat-safe shared-state framing for agent collaboration.
advance_reason: Distinctive WebMCP-native game concept with credible leverage and a live demo, though execution evidence is limited.

creativity_evidence: Image-to-3D home layout concept.
Multiple viewing angles and measured plans are part of the stated workflow.
usability_note: The stated goal is simple use, but no live interaction evidence is supplied.

standouts: Clear practical visualization use case for families and home designers.

one_line: Racing-line editor where agents inspect and create track layouts through structured WebMCP tools.
what_it_does: Lets users draw, edit, save, and view racing lines on satellite maps and in 3-D; agents can inspect circuit state and create missing layouts.
leverage_rationale: Racing-line editing depends on ordered points, track context, and stable shared state; semantic tools reduce coordinate guessing and make multi-step edits repeatable.
leverage_evidence: Agent reads circuit, reference line, and editor guidance, then creates two missing layouts directly.
Tools expose inspect, edit, undo, save/load against the same editor state.
execution_rationale: The packet gives a coherent standalone app, named implementation stack, persistence, tests, and a concrete multi-layout demo; absent transcript keeps this at claimed rather than observed strong execution.
execution_evidence: Demo alive; frame sheets show racing-line/map editor views.
Claims Vitest unit tests, Playwright browser tests, IndexedDB persistence, and 3-D WebGL view.
impact_rationale: Karting drivers and coaches have a specific need to study braking, apex, and acceleration points; a tool that accelerates track preparation has credible niche value.
impact_evidence: Description targets preparation for karting and unfamiliar tracks.
Lines encode braking, acceleration, and transition points.
creativity_rationale: Applying agent collaboration to a specialized racing-line workflow, including layout inference and visible edits, is a fresh hackathon-scale concept.
creativity_evidence: Agent creates missing alternate circuit layouts.
Combines satellite map, 3-D view, and structured racing semantics.
usability_note: No sign-in and visible undo/save semantics support approachable use; racing-line domain remains specialized.
red_flags: Video evidence is frame-sheet only and lacks transcript.
standouts: Concrete agent task with domain-specific constraints rather than generic CRUD.
advance_reason: Strong WebMCP delta, coherent domain workflow, and credible evidence of agent-created racing layouts.

impact_evidence: Booking and quote workflows are concrete and audience-relevant.

creativity_evidence: One engine adapts to distinct businesses and action types.

usability_note: Responsive presentation, provenance, and final human confirmation suggest a well-considered trust-oriented flow.

standouts: Reusable cross-business action publishing with human confirmation.
advance_reason: High-value, agent-centered business workflow with credible cross-domain execution and strong impact.

one_line: Parametric 3-D pottery editor that deterministically exports buildable multi-page clay templates.
what_it_does: Lets humans and agents shape vessel parameters while the application handles exact geometry, unfolding, pagination, and reversible export to printable templates.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP supplies the agent with parameter control while deterministic application geometry solves the precision and repeatability problem that generative chat output cannot reliably solve; paired browsers share live state.
leverage_evidence: Video transcript describes ChatGPT pairing via token/WebSocket and sub-second synchronization.
App owns deterministic multi-page geometry and supports undo/redo for human or agent changes.
execution_rationale: The 179-second video and transcript describe a complete parameter-to-template workflow, reversible edits, and visible output; minor uncertainty remains about broad robustness.
execution_evidence: Video is present with 179 seconds and transcript says the generated design arrived in the editor.
Frame sheet visibly shows a faceted vessel, technical counterpart, and design/document workflow.
About text claims printable multi-page PDF templates true to the 3-D shape.
impact_rationale: Potters have a concrete, costly failure mode when templates are misaligned; deterministic printable output can save studio time and enable complex forms.
impact_evidence: Description identifies hours lost discovering failed templates after building.
Target audience and output—potters and buildable clay templates—are specific.
creativity_rationale: The human-agent division of labor—AI handles complex exploration while a parametric app guarantees fabrication geometry—is an original and memorable interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Agent-controlled parametric pottery with paired-browser collaboration.

usability_note: Reversible edits, human parameter control, and pairing across browsers are strong usability choices, though pairing adds setup complexity.
red_flags: Pairing architecture may be more complex than native same-page WebMCP, but it is clearly demonstrated as a deliberate usability solution.
standouts: Excellent deterministic-vs-generative boundary and physical-world output.
advance_reason: Exceptional WebMCP leverage and originality, backed by unusually strong end-to-end product evidence.

one_line: Local-first, auditable data workbench for human-agent preparation and composition.
what_it_does: Imports local datasets, profiles and transforms them through recipes, composes validated operations, and exposes precise stateful WebMCP tools with human authority controls.
leverage_rationale: Stable IDs, dry runs, revision checks, idempotent operations, async polling, cancellation, and shared audit state directly solve the reliability and safety failures of UI-driving agents on dense data workflows.
leverage_evidence: Description enumerates semantic tools for inspect, validate, mutate, export, and monitor.

execution_evidence: Demo alive, public repository, and frame sheets submitted.

impact_evidence: Targets risky dense data preparation and privacy-sensitive workflows.

creativity_evidence: Privacy-safe activity ledger and semantic declassification.
Agent and human operate the same validated workflow state.
usability_note: Explicit authority and dry-run controls improve trust, but the breadth and density of the workbench may demand learning.
red_flags: No transcript or direct live invocation log in packet.
standouts: unusually rigorous safety and state semantics for agentic data manipulation.
advance_reason: One of the clearest cases where structured WebMCP materially changes reliability and safety, with strong product scope.

one_line: Basketball tactics board where coaches lock intent and agents repair only the remaining invalid actions.

one_line: Personal marketplace and extension for installing tested WebMCP tools onto sites that never shipped them.
what_it_does: Catalogs host-specific tools, obtains user approval, installs a constrained interpreter into real pages, tests and records touched elements/results, and supports agents in using the tools.
leverage_rationale: It extends structured agent surfaces to otherwise unsupported sites while preserving declared scopes, approval, deterministic operations, and recorded results; this changes capability rather than merely simplifying clicks.
leverage_evidence: Catalog, extension, and agent authoring workflow install tools into the page's real WebMCP surface.
Fixed nine-operation interpreter cannot reach undeclared network/storage targets and runs tools against the real page before publishing.
execution_rationale: The packet describes an ambitious end-to-end marketplace, extension, interpreter, testing, and SPA route handling; frame sheets support the product but no transcript is supplied.
execution_evidence: Demo alive, public repository, and frame sheets submitted.
Description covers discovery, consent, installation, testing, recording, and SPA route-change handling.
impact_rationale: The web has a vast long tail of sites without native tools; giving users a tested, consented path to reliable agent actions addresses a broad and concrete infrastructure gap.
impact_evidence: Explicit problem is that WebMCP only works when sites ship tools.
Catalog and extension target sites without adoption while keeping user approval and scope visibility.
creativity_rationale: A user-facing marketplace plus constrained tool interpreter for retrofitting WebMCP onto existing sites is a highly original and ambitious protocol adoption strategy.
creativity_evidence: Tools are ordinary once installed into the page's real surface.

standouts: Strong protocol-level ambition with constrained execution and proof-before-publish safeguards.
advance_reason: Broad impact, exceptional ambition, and a meaningful capability expansion for the WebMCP ecosystem.
